chapter: Heroes, heard bands and Lunceford's life on the road
title: The Lunceford band's baseball team in Central Park
summary: Crawford recalls the band's softball team, Lunceford as pitcher and himself as catcher.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Did you -- when you were in New York, were you involved in any of -- Rex Stewart wrote that there -- oftentimes in the late '20s and the '30s guys in the different bands would have baseball teams and basketball teams, stuff. Were you involved much in that?

Yeah, very much, with the Lunsford group. We had a nice baseball team on there, although I wasn't good enough to play baseball in high school band or with the baseball team. But we had a good baseball team. I was a better quarterback on the football team.
Did you all play many other bands?
Yes. Yes.
What were some of the better teams that you all played? Do you remember?
Well, everybody had -- they started to sneaking those, you know, just guys from the outside, sneaking them in there, playing against us, because they knew they had to play.
(Laughter)
Yeah, they -- they were something else. Yeah, Calloway's band, ones he could sneak in from the outside and all the bands had baseball teams mostly.
Where did you all play?
I don't know -- Central Park mostly.
Mostly Central Park.
Yeah, we had a heck of a team.
Would you -- I mean would that be like -- like if you all went to play baseball in Central Park --
I was the catcher.
You were the catcher? You played catcher, huh? Who pitched for the team?
Lunsford
Oh, Lunsford was the pitcher, was he?
We played mostly softball, and he had the fastest and strongest softball (inaudible) I ever
caught. Oh, he could throw. Lunsford was an athlete anyway, very much athletically inclined. Oh, he was -- he was a great player.
Who were some of the good hitters. Do you remember any of the good hitters from around the different bands?
I don't remember. We only played softball. Couldn't hit it but so far, but you -- guys nowadays is up in the big leagues, to manage softball teams. Yes.
